title: Normalized native left comparison and representing counit lifts
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell$ different from its characteristic, and a normalized realization family $R$ [def-sf-native-exceptional-forgetful-data]. For each separated finite-type model $T_0$, let $U_T$ be actual derived forgetting including closure transport, $C_T$ the common-stage constructible category and $\rho_T$ its realization. There are simultaneous ForgetModels $V_T:\mathcal W(T_0)\to C_T$ with $V_T\rho_T\simeq U_T$ such that the following holds. For every separated finite-type model morphism $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$, every normalized coefficient system $S$ and compactification $c$ of its geometric base change, write $F\dashv G$ for the specified ordinary adjunction and $F^W$ for native compact support. There is a natural isomorphism $a:F^W V_Y\simeq V_XF$ such that, for each $L\in\mathcal W(Y_0)$, there are $H\in\mathcal W(X_0)$, $e:V_XH\simeq G(V_YL)$ and $d:F^WH\to L$ with $V_Yd=a_H;F(e);\epsilon_{V_YL}$. For every $K\in\mathcal W(X_0)$ the map $v\mapsto F^W(v);d$ is a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(K,H)\to\operatorname{Hom}(F^WK,L)$. Semicolons denote composition in displayed order. No native right adjoint is assumed.

proof.text: Use exact native forgetting and the coefficient-heart comparison to identify the bounded constructible underlying categories. Closure transport is an exact equivalence; Family full faithfulness and essential image lift U to V on every derived morphism. Compose the native open/proper comparison with inverse scalar normalization and compactification refinement, and lift through rho to obtain a.

The scalar-normalized adjunction has an invertible Frobenius mate and invariant counit. Apply the lifted-counit representability theorem on the bounded constructible full subcategories. Exact open extension and total right-derived proper image satisfy its normalized boundary compatibility by finite-composite cyclic Hom functoriality. Transport the representing H,e,d and full Hom bijection back through the closure and realization equivalences. The coinvariant degree -1 term is retained.

lean.statement:
theorem native_exceptional_left_models (R : Family l D) :
    ∃ model : ∀ T : Space D, ForgetModel D l R T,
      ∀ (X Y : Space D) (f₀ : X.base ⟶ Y.base)
        [IsSeparated f₀.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀.left] [QuasiCompact f₀.left]
        (S : CoefficientSystem D l f₀) (c : Compactification (geometricMap D f₀)),
      ∃ a : nativeShriek D l f₀ ⋙ (model Y).functor ≅
          (model X).functor ⋙ (S.ring.operation c .closed).F,
        ∀ L : W D l Y, ∃ (H : W D l X)
          (e : (model X).functor.obj H ≅
            (S.ring.operation c .closed).G.obj ((model Y).functor.obj L))
          (d : (nativeShriek D l f₀).obj H ⟶ L),
          (model Y).functor.map d = a.hom.app H ≫
            (S.ring.operation c .closed).F.map e.hom ≫
            (S.ring.operation c .closed).adjunction.counit.app ((model Y).functor.obj L) ∧
          ∀ K : W D l X,
            Function.Bijective (fun v : K ⟶ H ↦ (nativeShriek D l f₀).map v ≫ d)
